title: Wrestling Classics: Olde Timey Pro Wrestling
description:
Before High Flying Dives, Cage Matches, Tag Teams, Irish Whips and Choke Slams, there was just Pro Wrestling. Get back to the origins of Pro Wrestling in this throwback to the 1920s.

The first ever wrestling video game focused on the origins of pro wrestling!

Modes:

• Exhibition (Play or Simulate)

• Championship (Take on a series of competitors to become the Pro-Wrestling Heavyweight Champion of the World)

• Tournament Mode

• Edit (Customize the wrestlers and create your own)

• Training Mode
